# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest code on `main`.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| `main`  | Yes       |
| Older commits and branches | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not disclose security vulnerabilities publicly.

Preferred reporting method:

1. Open a private report via GitHub Security Advisories in this repository (`Security` tab -> `Report a vulnerability`).

Fallback:

1. If private reporting is unavailable, open a public issue without exploit details and request a private contact path.

Response expectations:

- This is a solo-maintained project, so response and remediation are best effort.
- I aim to acknowledge valid reports within 7 business days.
- I will provide updates when there is meaningful progress.
- Validated issues will be fixed on `main` and disclosed responsibly.

Please include clear reproduction steps, impact, affected versions/components, and any proposed mitigations.
